requirements: Reject fields not allowed by the schema.
Treat submission_id as idempotency key; a retry must not create a duplicate row.
Do not persist request IP address, User-Agent, referrer, or analytics identifiers in the research dataset.
Keep infrastructure/request logging disabled or minimized and separately governed; do not claim anonymity until this is verified for the chosen host.
Store received_at only as coarse date or month unless exact timing is demonstrably needed.
Hash the supplied token using the same one-way function used by the client and match only the stored hash.
Never log the plaintext withdrawal token.
Delete the matching contribution and recompute aggregates.
Never return raw dimension vectors or contribution rows.
Suppress pattern-level output below the configured minimum cell size.
Separate statistics by model/questionnaire/derivation version rather than mixing incompatible cohorts.
